reviews.text: I highly recommend Dr. Paula to everyone. She's a lovely person and an exceptional professional. You can see that she truly loves her profession; she's sensitive and attentive—words fail to describe her. ✨🫶🏼 …
Dr. Paula is a sweetheart with the dogs and an excellent professional.

An excellent vet! That was my last comment some years ago, but now recently they helped our little puppy newcomer to the family ! A female border collie named Isha, that had to be hospitalised with diarrhea! They were wonderful and very professional Dr Paula and Dr Joana, were able to save our puppy! We are gratefull and totally recommend this veterinarians! Besides they absolutely love animals , they have cats and dogs that keep u company when u arrive ! Just lovely 😍

A team of amazing people, lovely with humans and exceptional with pets.
I travel miles just for them when I need to!
The most humane veterinarians I've ever met. I recommend them to everyone.

My dog ​​was being treated at another clinic, but today I had an urgent situation and they opened the door for me as if I were part of the family. Besides being patient with her, as she is anxious and gets scared in a veterinary environment, they were incredibly kind and attentive. They managed to treat her and were patient enough to wait for her to calm down.
